claims.quote: R2: auth.sessionTtlMinutes must be between 5 and 120 inclusive

claims.text: The value of auth.sessionTtlMinutes in settings.json is 600.
R2 is not met because 600 exceeds the maximum of 120.

The value of features.beta in settings.json is false.
RULES.md rule R4 requires smtp.host to end with ".example.com".

RULES.md rule R5 requires retention.days to be at least 30.
claims.quote: R5: retention.days must be at least 30

claims.text: The value of retention.days in settings.json is 310.
settings.json is not compliant with RULES.md.
The only violation is rule R2: auth.sessionTtlMinutes is 600, above the maximum of 120.
